# Bash commands allowed without asking in the edit-repo profile (denied in none and read-only,
# which have no Bash tool). One command per line; "#" lines and blank lines are ignored.

node --version
git status
git status --short
git diff
git diff --stat HEAD~1
git log --oneline -n 10
git show HEAD
git rev-parse HEAD
git ls-files
ls
ls -la src
ls src/*.ts
pwd
cat package.json
cat .env.example
cat .gitignore
head -n 20 README.md
tail -n 50 server.log
wc -l src/index.ts
grep -n TODO src/index.ts
find . -name '*.ts' -not -path './node_modules/*'
tree -L 2 src
mkdir -p src/components
git status; git diff
ls src | wc -l
cat package.json | grep version
